title_en: As far as: do with the genitive
card_en: Do means to or as far as, and the noun after it takes the genitive, as after ni: postaja becomes do postaje, center becomes do centra.

example.en: How do I get to the station?

the station.en: How do I get to the station?

the bank.en: How do I get to the bank?

the centre.en: How do I get to the centre?

the shop.en: How do I get to the shop?

quick_check.explain_en: After do, trgovina takes the genitive: do trgovine.

helper_de: do is close to German bis zu, but it takes the genitive: do postaje.
helper_en: English to never changes the noun; after do, the noun changes: do postaje, do centra.
